title: The glossary row for the stable branch says it exists on origin
why: Finding (the #3407 lane's reviewer, outside that diff; coordinator 11:56 CST Nov 14, relayed). Triage read both sides. GLOSSARY.md line 29 (stable clone of main, read 11:57 CST): "stable branch ... Target, not live: no `stable` branch is on origin yet." `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/stable` at 11:57 CST returns 0806bf59d2847e36dcaa977e0560cca8a8fbc90e, the same commit as the #3404 merge on main. So the row is false now. Whether the branch is live in the sense of the decision stable-branch (moves only to a green main commit, fast-forward only; reinstall works from it) is not measured here. Fix: rewrite the row in place to say the branch exists and where it points, with a claim bound to a check (skill fresh-prose). Docs only; a record-writer; the glossary row is read by every session. Kin: stable-switch-map-check, missing-stable-warn-hook, push-skip-text-says-stable.
